issue.title: Mac shorthand test does not compile: CapturePreviewState.pending does not exist
issue.description: Found by bob-cli-3l.land while verifying phase bob-cli-3l.2 (not proposed by that phase). Mac CI run 37057373509 on bob-mac-capture 68ed00db214eeac5b75716887f982d00cad397fa passes format lint and production Build, but the Test step fails compiling CapturePanelModelTests.swift:2024 because testCloseAliasPreviewSubmitsUntouchedDraft matches .pending on CapturePreviewState. Source defines only idle/loading/ready/failed. git blame attributes the failing line to aa1e73a8, before bob-cli-3l was created; 68ed00d leaves it unchanged. Pending close cards actually expose closePendingText/isClosePending with a ready trimmed preview, so repair the test to wait for that state and assert that submission stays disabled and the pending preview is correct; do not invent a production enum case. Use sase repo open bob-mac-capture, or gh:bobs-org/bob-mac-capture when the configured primary is absent, and read only its printed checkout. Verify the targeted model test and macOS SwiftPM suite. No current active epic owns this pre-epic shorthand test; bob-cli-1u is a closed Linux process-termination issue with a different cause.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic compiler error: the enum has no pending member. CI reports it at line 2024, and inspection plus git blame confirms the unchanged invalid reference from aa1e73a8. This is not a runtime timeout or intermittent assertion.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-3l land audit found a confirmed pre-existing macOS CI compilation failure that prevents the new unnumbered-bullet tests from executing. Track the faulty shorthand-test expectation separately from the positional Work Log epic.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by bob-cli-3u.land on bob-mac-capture 680e17f (+ bob-cli-3u landing fixes) and on pre-epic 68ed00d: building the test targets on a macOS 26 / Swift 6.3.2 Command Line Tools Mac (XCTest replaced by a throwaway assertion stand-in so the suite could compile and run) still fails at Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CapturePanelModelTests.swift:2024 'type CapturePreviewState has no member pending' inside testCloseAliasInvalidBlocksSubmissionAndClearsStaleCard. Impact: every push since aa1e73a (incl. bob-cli-3u's 680e17f, run 37134501063, and its landing commit) can never get past the CI Test step, so new Mac tests are never exercised by CI. With the line patched in scratch, that test still times out at lines 2015/2023, so the repair must rework the wait conditions as this bead describes, not just swap the enum case.

Independent CI evidence from the bob-cli-41 landing. macOS 26 SwiftPM runs 37157187639 (e9b5f81, plus-picker feature) and 37158683771 (098e67e, plus-picker fixtures) both pass Lint and Build, then fail Test at Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CapturePanelModelTests.swift:2024 because CapturePreviewState has no member pending (if case .pending = model.previewState). The new plus-picker tests never executed. Same line and cause as this bead's report on run 37057373509.

payload.entry: Fixed the invalid CapturePreviewState.pending test expectation and verified green macOS CI: https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/37195267624 (SHA 0040a64c97f4afa0d4c799ad3ae49d954b99ba16).
